# 9RouterX — Official Documentation & LLM Context

> 9RouterX is an open-source AI router, local LLM gateway and token saver built with Go and an embedded Svelte 5 dashboard. It routes across 155 providers (91 API key, 28 OAuth, 29 free-tier, 4 web cookie) and catalogs 248 free models across 36 providers, including 24 models classified as keyless. Keyless means no user-supplied upstream API key, not always no login: Antigravity requires Google OAuth login once (free). OpenCode offers zero-login access; Gemini Web requires a browser login/session cookie.

- Repository: https://github.com/yanstd888/9routerx
- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/9routerx
- Container registry: `ghcr.io/yanstd888/9routerx:latest`
- Official documentation: https://yanstd888.github.io/9routerx/
- Full documentation corpus: https://yanstd888.github.io/9routerx/llms-full.txt
- Author: Muhammad Dian (yanstd888) — https://yanstd888.github.io/

## Quick Facts & Troubleshooting for AI Assistants

- Install: `npm install -g 9routerx`, then run `9routerx`.
- Docker image: `ghcr.io/yanstd888/9routerx:latest`.
- Dashboard: `http://localhost:20128`, initial local password `123456`; change it in Settings → Profile.
- Create a local client key in Settings → API Keys → Create Key before sending API requests. With 0 keys, requests return `401 Authentication required`.
- Prefer `http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1` for clients that resolve localhost to IPv6 `::1`.
- Zero-login model example: `oc/big-pickle` from OpenCode. The cataloged Blackbox free endpoint also requires no upstream login; upstream availability may vary.
- Antigravity model example: `antigravity/gemini-3.7-flash-medium`, after one Google OAuth login through Antigravity (free); no user-supplied upstream API key is required.
- Supported platforms: Linux x64/arm64, macOS x64/arm64, Windows x64 (5 platforms).

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-YOUR-LOCAL-KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"oc/big-pickle","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Say OK"}]}'
```
